title: Laboratory retention statement
purpose: Record or clear the laboratory’s own electronic record-retention statement with a reason.
summary: Record, change or clear the laboratory's electronic record-retention statement, with a reason.

tasks.title: Change the retention statement
steps: Edit [[Record retention statement]]. Leave it blank to clear it.

tasks.title: Check earlier changes
steps: Select [[History]]. The full reason and before/after text are in the audit history.

good_to_know: The statement does not delete records or dispose of samples automatically.
If someone else saved first, the save is refused. Reload and review their statement.
The statement must actually change, and the reason is required.
Address, logo and certificates printed on reports are changed in Setup → Laboratory profile.

sections.title: Access and fields
paragraphs: Requires an active staff superuser with the laboratory admin role.

This maintenance form changes only the retention statement. The address, contact details, logo, certificates and certificate statement printed on reports are changed on the Laboratory profile page under Setup.

items.label: Timezone
items.description: Read-only recorded setup timezone. New input parsing/report presentation use deployment TIME_ZONE, not an editable override here.

items.label: Record retention statement
items.description: Optional maximum 8000-character statement; whitespace is trimmed. Blank clears it to Not recorded. It configures no automatic electronic deletion or physical sample disposal schedule.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required nonblank explanation, maximum 2000 characters; retained with actor and before/after evidence.

items.label: Revision check
items.description: Hidden expected revision, prefilled from the opened record. The current record is locked and rechecked; a stale save requires reloading and reviewing the new statement.

sections.title: Saving rules
paragraphs: The statement must actually change after trimming. Statement, incremented revision and attributed retention audit event commit together. Validation failures keep the form open. Lab name/timezone cannot be edited here, and lab creation/deletion are unavailable. Physical sample retain-through dates are a separate workflow.

items.label: Save
items.description: Saves a valid changed statement and returns to the lab list.

items.label: Save and continue editing
items.description: Saves and reopens the lab form with its new revision.

items.label: History
items.description: Opens the separate Django administration log; the full retention reason and before/after statement are in the domain audit event.

items.label: Save and add another / Delete
items.description: Not offered: adding and deleting laboratories are disabled.

items.label: Home / Core / Labs / View site
items.description: Breadcrumbs return through maintenance; View site returns to the operational application.
